name: Avg days (prior)
varlab: Average presence days per cohort member in the look-back (prior) period; blank for No data and origin zones

name: Avg days (follow-up)
varlab: Average presence days per cohort member in the follow-up period; blank for No data and origin zones

name: Log2 ratio
varlab: Log base-2 ratio of follow-up to prior average presence days: log2(follow-up / prior); blank for No data and origin zones

name: Flag
varlab: Data quality flag: 'No data' = zone excluded from analysis; 'Origin' = cohort origin zone; blank = included
